description: Cold-path helper for Node, which cannot call flock. Node opens the lock file (O_RDWR) and hands that fd in slot 3; the helper locks the inherited description and exits. The lock stays with the description Node owns. The helper is never the owner.

exactlyOne.meaning: one non-blocking LOCK_EX attempt on fd 3
LOCK_EX attempts until N milliseconds elapsed (N integer >= 1); the caller still kills the helper on its own deadline
one non-blocking LOCK_SH attempt on fd 3; result free or held; the caller closes fd 3 afterwards

borrower test for hooks: fd 3 must have the same dev:ino as <path> and a non-blocking LOCK_EX on it must succeed (a description that already holds the lock succeeds; a sibling that opened the file itself fails). On Windows it takes no slot and uses FGOS_LOCK_JOB (holder-lock.port.v1.json borrowerCheck)
path-based shared try, no fd needed (Node on Windows): result free or held; the shared lock is dropped at once
read-only: one pass of the contender view on the predecessor record next to <lockFile>; never kills; result predecessor
no fd needed; print the guarantee of the directory <path> lives in

optional.meaning: predecessor record path; default <lock file>.predecessor.json derived from fd 3

fds.in: POSIX: fd 3 = the lock file description (inherited, O_RDWR). The helper sets FD_CLOEXEC on it before any other syscall. Windows: the path-based flags (--probe, --predecessor-state, --borrowed-check) read no slot.
fds.out: stdout = one JSON line then newline; stderr = free text for humans, never parsed

held.domain: predecessor domain record, only for predecessor-domain-not-empty

predecessor.domain: predecessor domain record, absent when state is absent
predecessor.reason: string, present when state is not-empty or unknown (e.g. predecessor-other-session, no-judge-on-this-platform, record-unknown-shape, record-not-json, record-unreadable); record-unreadable adds detail, record-not-json names domain {raw: first 120 characters}

exitCodes.3: protocol mismatch (result error, code host-version-mismatch; --protocol absent or != 1)

invariants: after --try/--wait-ms with result acquired, the lock lives on the caller's description; helper exit must not release it
on held (kernel-lock-held), timeout and unavailable the helper never took a lock on the description

on held (predecessor-domain-not-empty) the kernel lock was taken on the caller's description before the predecessor rule ran; the helper cannot drop it without LOCK_UN, so the caller's close releases it
the helper never leaves fd 3 open in a child it spawns (it spawns none)

callerRules.timeout: wait with spawnSync and killSignal SIGKILL; when it returns the helper is dead and reaped; close the fd; the result is not-acquired unless the stdout line says acquired
callerRules.afterAcquire: check fstat(fd).ino == stat(path).ino; otherwise close and retry
callerRules.notAcquired: close fd 3 on every result other than acquired (required for held predecessor-domain-not-empty, harmless otherwise); never retry on the same description
callerRules.resolution: exec the binary named by FGOS_HOST_BIN or the activation, resolved once per process; never through a shim; never inside a hot lock
